title: The Quiet Typewriter
author: Bram Dunmore
blurb: Lena Underhill, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
